build_data2vec_audio_model: build a Data2VecAudioModel instance from a Data2VecAudioConfig for self-supervised audio pretraining
extract_audio_features: extract features from audio source tensors using the Data2VecAudioModel extract_features method
apply_temporal_masking: apply temporal and channel masking to audio feature tensors using the apply_mask method
compute_annealed_ema_decay: compute the annealed EMA decay rate between start and end values using get_annealed_rate
remove_pretraining_modules: remove pretraining modules like final_proj and EMA from a trained Data2VecAudioModel for fine-tuning
